description: Establish and confirm the baseline build/test state before adding the realtime battle feature, and record the exact commands the user runs on a networked host. This is a verification/orientation feature: the sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (npm registry 403), so installs/builds/tests CANNOT run here. Confirm the repo is on branch feat/realtime-battle and that no changes are needed to make the existing baseline coherent.
steps: Confirm the working directory is the repo root /projects/sandbox/Quiz-app and git branch is feat/realtime-battle (git status, git branch --show-current). Do NOT switch branches.

Read package.json (root) and frontend/package.json to confirm scripts: root build=tsc, test=jest, cdk=cdk; frontend build=`tsc -b && vite build`. Confirm root devDeps already include @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb + @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb + esbuild + @types/aws-lambda + ts-jest.
Read jest.config.js and tsconfig.json to confirm ts-jest is configured to compile lambda/ + test/ TypeScript.

Attempt `npm ci` at the root ONLY to confirm it fails with the expected registry 403 (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY). Do NOT treat this failure as a blocker; it is expected. Record that builds/tests must be run by the user on a networked host.
Record in this feature's findings the exact user-run verification commands: root `npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth`; frontend `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`.
acceptance_criteria: git branch is feat/realtime-battle and the working tree state is understood.
Root and frontend package.json scripts and existing dependencies are confirmed and documented in findings.
The INTEGRATIONS_ONLY constraint is confirmed (npm ci at root fails with a registry error) and the user-run command sequence is recorded in findings.
No source files are modified in this feature.
verification: Run `git -C /projects/sandbox/Quiz-app branch --show-current` and confirm it prints feat/realtime-battle.
Run `git -C /projects/sandbox/Quiz-app status --porcelain` and confirm no unintended modifications were introduced by this orientation feature.
findings:
BRANCH: `git branch --show-current` => feat/realtime-battle (correct; not switched). `git status --porcelain` shows only the untracked .agents/tasks/task-realtime-battle/ task-state dir; NO source files were touched by this orientation feature.

ROOT package.json CONFIRMED: scripts build=tsc, test=jest, watch=tsc -w, cdk=cdk. dependencies: aws-cdk-lib ^2.156.0, constructs ^10.3.0. devDependencies already include: aws-cdk ^2.156.0, typescript ~5.5.4, ts-node ^10.9.2, @types/node ^22.5.0, jest ^29.7.0, ts-jest ^29.1.5, @types/jest ^29.5.12, esbuild ^0.23.1, @types/aws-lambda ^8.10.145, @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb ^3.658.0, @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb ^3.658.0. So the handler unit tests can import DynamoDB SDK types/values while esbuild keeps @aws-sdk/* external at bundle time. NOTE: @aws-sdk/client-apigatewaymanagementapi is NOT (and per context should NOT be) added here unless needed as a devDep type source; it is provided by the Lambda Node runtime and stays esbuild-external.

ROOT tsconfig.json CONFIRMED: commonjs/ES2022, strict:true, esModuleInterop, resolveJsonModule, experimentalDecorators; exclude [node_modules, cdk.out]. No explicit include, so tsc compiles all .ts (lambda/, lib/, bin/, test/).

jest.config.js CONFIRMED: testEnvironment node, roots ['<rootDir>/test'], testMatch ['**/*.test.ts'], transform { '^.+\\.tsx?$': 'ts-jest' }. So ts-jest compiles the TypeScript test suite (which imports the real exported pure helpers from lambda/index.ts and, once added, lambda/ws.ts).

FRONTEND frontend/package.json CONFIRMED: separate npm project, type=module, scripts dev=vite, build=`tsc -b && vite build`, preview=vite preview. dependencies EXACTLY react ^18.3.1 + react-dom ^18.3.1 (must stay exactly these two: native browser WebSocket only, no new deps). devDeps: @types/node, @types/react ^18.3.3, @types/react-dom ^18.3.0, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.1, typescript ~5.5.4, vite ^5.4.0.

NO LOCKFILES committed in either project (confirmed by npm ci failing on missing package-lock.json). Do NOT create one.

ENVIRONMENT / INTEGRATIONS_ONLY CONFIRMED: npm must be invoked with an `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` prefix in this sandbox (a NODE_OPTIONS preload of /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js otherwise crashes node with MODULE_NOT_FOUND). `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci` at root fails with EUSAGE (no committed lockfile). `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm install --dry-run` at root fails with `npm error code E403 / 403 Forbidden - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@aws-sdk%2fclient-dynamodb`, confirming the npm registry is blocked. This 403 is EXPECTED under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY and is NOT a blocker. Consequently npm install / npm ci / tsc / jest / cdk synth / vite build CANNOT run in this sandbox; all subsequent features must be authored correct-by-construction and verified by reading.

USER-RUN VERIFICATION COMMANDS (on a networked host; prefix npm with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` only if the same NODE_OPTIONS preload issue occurs):
  Backend (repo root): `npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth`  (then `npx cdk deploy` to deploy).
  Frontend: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`  (`npm run dev` for local at http://localhost:5173).
  After deploy: set the new Amplify env var WS_URL to the WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput value and redeploy the frontend.
